q.id: Locator mana yang paling dianjurkan Playwright untuk tombol "Masuk"?
q.en: Which locator does Playwright recommend most for a "Sign in" button?

id: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Masuk' })
page.locator('div > div:nth-child(3) > button')
page.locator('.btn.btn-primary.mt-4')
page.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/button')
en: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Masuk' })
page.locator('div > div:nth-child(3) > button')
page.locator('.btn.btn-primary.mt-4')
page.locator('xpath=/html/body/div[2]/button')

exp.id: getByRole mencerminkan cara user dan teknologi bantu melihat halaman, sehingga tahan terhadap perubahan struktur DOM atau class CSS. Ketiga lainnya bergantung pada struktur atau styling yang mudah berubah.
exp.en: getByRole mirrors how users and assistive technology see the page, so it survives DOM or CSS class changes. The others depend on structure or styling that changes easily.

q.id: Mana assertion yang memakai mekanisme retry otomatis (web-first assertion)?
q.en: Which assertion uses automatic retrying (a web-first assertion)?

id: expect(await locator.isVisible()).toBe(true)
await expect(locator).toBeVisible()
expect(await locator.textContent()).toBeTruthy()
if (await locator.count() > 0) { /* lanjut */ }
en: expect(await locator.isVisible()).toBe(true)
await expect(locator).toBeVisible()
expect(await locator.textContent()).toBeTruthy()
if (await locator.count() > 0) { /* continue */ }

exp.id: expect(locator) mengulang pemeriksaan sampai terpenuhi atau timeout. Pola lain membaca nilai sekali lalu membandingkannya, sehingga rawan flaky bila UI belum siap.
exp.en: expect(locator) re-checks until the condition holds or times out. The other patterns read a value once and compare it, which is flaky when the UI is not ready yet.

q.id: Mengapa test Playwright dijalankan di browser context yang baru per test?
q.en: Why does Playwright run each test in a fresh browser context?

id: Context baru mengunduh ulang seluruh browser sehingga hasilnya lebih akurat
Context memberi isolasi seperti profil browser bersih (cookie, storage) dengan biaya kecil
Context diperlukan supaya test bisa berjalan di lebih dari satu bahasa pemrograman
Context membuat test otomatis lulus walaupun aplikasi sedang bermasalah
en: A fresh context downloads the whole browser again so results are more accurate
A context gives clean-profile isolation (cookies, storage) at low cost
A context is needed so tests can run in more than one programming language
A context makes tests pass automatically even when the app has problems

exp.id: Context itu ringan dan terisolasi, jadi test tidak saling mewariskan state tanpa harus membuka browser baru. Ia tidak mengunduh browser dan tidak memengaruhi hasil lulus atau gagal.
exp.en: A context is lightweight and isolated, so tests do not inherit each other's state without launching a new browser. It does not download browsers or influence pass/fail results.

q.id: Bagaimana cara menghindari login lewat UI di setiap test Playwright?
q.en: How do you avoid logging in through the UI in every Playwright test?

id: Login sekali, simpan storageState, lalu pakai ulang di context test lain
Menaruh password di URL halaman supaya otomatis masuk
Menjalankan seluruh test dalam satu test panjang tanpa pemisahan
Menonaktifkan autentikasi di aplikasi selama semua test berjalan
en: Log in once, save the storageState and reuse it in other test contexts
Putting the password in the page URL so you are signed in automatically
Running all checks inside one very long test with no separation
Turning authentication off in the app while every test runs

exp.id: storageState menyimpan cookie dan local storage hasil login sehingga test berikutnya langsung berstatus masuk, cepat dan tetap terisolasi. Opsi lain tidak aman atau merusak independensi test.
exp.en: storageState keeps the login cookies and local storage so later tests start signed in, fast and still isolated. The other options are unsafe or break test independence.

q.id: Anda ingin menguji tampilan error saat API mengembalikan 500 tanpa mengubah backend. Apa yang dipakai?
q.en: You want to test the UI error state when the API returns 500 without changing the backend. What do you use?

id: page.route() untuk mencegat request dan memberi respons 500 palsu
page.pause() agar Anda mematikan server secara manual
page.setViewportSize() untuk mengubah ukuran layar
test.skip() supaya skenario error tidak perlu diuji
en: page.route() to intercept the request and fulfil it with a fake 500 response
page.pause() so you switch the server off by hand
page.setViewportSize() to change the screen size
test.skip() so the error scenario need not be tested

exp.id: page.route menyadap request jaringan dan memungkinkan stub respons (status, body), cocok untuk menguji state error dan loading secara deterministik.
exp.en: page.route intercepts network requests and lets you stub the response (status, body), which suits deterministic error and loading states.

q.id: Test gagal hanya di CI dan Anda tidak bisa mereproduksinya lokal. Fitur Playwright apa yang paling membantu?
q.en: A test fails only in CI and you cannot reproduce it locally. Which Playwright feature helps most?

id: Trace viewer: rekaman langkah, snapshot DOM, dan jaringan dari run yang gagal
Mengganti semua locator dengan XPath absolut supaya terlihat lebih presisi dan pasti
Menambah page.waitForTimeout(10000) di awal setiap test supaya semuanya lebih lambat
Menghapus assertion yang gagal dari test supaya pipeline CI kembali berwarna hijau
en: Trace viewer: recorded steps, DOM snapshots and network from the failed run
Replacing every locator with absolute XPath expressions to make them more precise
Adding page.waitForTimeout(10000) at the start of every test to slow things down
Deleting the failing assertion from the test so the CI pipeline turns green again

exp.id: Trace (misalnya trace: 'on-first-retry') merekam apa yang terjadi saat test gagal sehingga bisa diputar ulang. Sleep tetap dan menghapus assertion menyembunyikan masalah, bukan menemukannya.
exp.en: A trace (e.g. trace: 'on-first-retry') records what happened during the failure so it can be replayed. Fixed sleeps and deleting assertions hide the problem instead of finding it.

q.id: Secara default, bagaimana Playwright Test menjalankan test secara paralel?
q.en: By default, how does Playwright Test run tests in parallel?

id: Antar file test berjalan paralel lewat beberapa worker; test dalam satu file berurutan
Semua test dalam satu file berjalan paralel tetapi antar file berurutan
Semua test selalu berurutan di satu proses tanpa pengecualian
Paralel hanya bila memakai Selenium Grid bersama Playwright
en: Test files run in parallel across workers; tests inside one file run in order
All tests in one file run in parallel but files run one after another
All tests always run sequentially in one process with no exceptions
Parallelism works only when using Selenium Grid together with Playwright

exp.id: Worker menjalankan file berbeda secara paralel; test dalam satu file berurutan kecuali fullyParallel diaktifkan. Karena itu test data antar worker tidak boleh bertabrakan.
exp.en: Workers run different files in parallel; tests within a file run in order unless fullyParallel is enabled. So test data must not collide across workers.

q.id: Apa fungsi fixture di Playwright Test?
q.en: What are fixtures for in Playwright Test?

id: Menyiapkan dan membersihkan dependensi test (halaman login, test data) secara terisolasi dan dapat dipakai ulang
Mengunci versi browser di proyek supaya tidak pernah ikut diperbarui oleh release Playwright
Menerjemahkan test secara otomatis ke bahasa pemrograman lain ketika tim memintanya
Menggantikan kebutuhan assertion dengan menyimpan screenshot di akhir setiap test
en: Setting up and tearing down test dependencies (signed-in page, test data) in an isolated, reusable way
Pinning the browser version in the project so that it is never updated by Playwright releases
Automatically translating the tests into another programming language when the team asks
Replacing the need for assertions by saving a screenshot at the end of every test

exp.id: Fixture mendeklarasikan apa yang dibutuhkan test (misalnya authedPage) dan Playwright menyiapkan serta membersihkannya per test.
exp.en: A fixture declares what a test needs (e.g. an authed page) and Playwright sets it up and cleans it per test.

q.id: Klik tombol membuka tab baru (popup). Bagaimana pendekatan yang tepat di Playwright?
q.en: Clicking a button opens a new tab (popup). What is the right approach in Playwright?

id: Mulai menunggu event popup, klik tombol, lalu gunakan page popup yang dihasilkan
Mustahil, karena Playwright hanya mendukung satu tab per test dan mengabaikan jendela baru
Pakai Thread.sleep(5000) setelah klik lalu tebak tab mana yang sedang aktif saat itu
Muat ulang halaman awal berulang kali sampai tab baru tidak muncul lagi setelah klik
en: Start waiting for the popup event, click the button, then use the resulting popup page
Impossible, because Playwright supports only one tab per test and ignores new windows
Use Thread.sleep(5000) after the click and then guess which of the tabs is active now
Reload the original page repeatedly until the new tab stops appearing after each click

exp.id: Pola const popupPromise = page.waitForEvent('popup'); klik; const popup = await popupPromise menangani tab baru tanpa race. Playwright mendukung banyak page dalam satu context.
exp.en: The pattern const popupPromise = page.waitForEvent('popup'); click; const popup = await popupPromise handles new tabs without a race. Playwright supports many pages in one context.

q.id: Apa kegunaan perintah codegen Playwright?
q.en: What is Playwright's codegen command for?

id: Merekam interaksi di browser dan menghasilkan kode test awal yang perlu dirapikan
Membuat bug report rinci ke Jira secara otomatis tanpa campur tangan manusia sama sekali
Mengompilasi aplikasi yang diuji menjadi paket instalasi untuk setiap platform
Menghapus seluruh cache browser milik semua user yang pernah mengunjungi situs
en: Recording browser interactions and generating starter test code that needs tidying
Automatically filing detailed bug reports in Jira without any human involvement at all
Compiling the application under test into an installer package for every platform
Clearing the whole browser cache of every user who has ever visited the website

exp.id: Codegen membantu memulai script dengan cepat, tetapi hasilnya tetap perlu ditinjau: locator, assertion, dan struktur.
exp.en: Codegen helps start scripts quickly, but the output still needs review: locators, assertions and structure.

q.id: Mengapa kode ini keliru? const nama = cy.get('#nama').text();
q.en: Why is this code wrong? const name = cy.get('#name').text();

id: Perintah cy.* diantrikan dan tidak mengembalikan nilai langsung; gunakan .then() atau alias
Cypress sama sekali tidak bisa membaca elemen lewat atribut id, hanya lewat class atau teks
Variabel const dilarang di setiap file test Cypress, sehingga harus selalu memakai let
Metode text() memang ada tetapi hanya berjalan ketika test dieksekusi di browser Firefox
en: cy.* commands are queued and do not return values directly; use .then() or an alias
Cypress cannot read elements by their id attribute at all, only by class name or text
const variables are forbidden in every Cypress test file, so let must always be used
The text() method exists but it only runs when the tests are executed in Firefox

exp.id: Cypress menyusun queue perintah asinkron; cy.get tidak mengembalikan elemen sebagai nilai biasa dan jQuery text() tidak tersedia di chain Cypress. Ambil nilai lewat .then(($el) => ...).
exp.en: Cypress builds an async command queue; cy.get does not return the element as a plain value, and jQuery's text() is not on the Cypress chain. Read values via .then(($el) => ...).

q.id: Untuk menunggu request tertentu selesai sebelum assertion, apa yang dianjurkan?
q.en: To wait for a specific request to finish before asserting, what is recommended?

id: cy.intercept() dengan alias, lalu cy.wait('@alias')
cy.wait(5000) supaya dianggap "cukup lama" untuk request apa pun
Memanggil Date.now() berulang di dalam loop while sampai nilainya berubah
Menutup browser lalu membukanya lagi sebelum setiap assertion dijalankan
en: cy.intercept() with an alias, then cy.wait('@alias')
cy.wait(5000) so that it is "long enough" for any request
Calling Date.now() repeatedly inside a while loop until its value changes
Closing the browser and opening it again before every assertion is run

exp.id: Menunggu alias request bergantung pada kejadian nyata, bukan tebakan waktu. Sleep tetap membuat test lambat sekaligus tetap rawan flaky.
exp.en: Waiting on a request alias depends on a real event, not a time guess. Fixed sleeps make tests slow and still flaky.

q.id: Apa arti retry-ability di Cypress?
q.en: What does retry-ability mean in Cypress?

id: Query seperti cy.get dan assertion yang mengikutinya diulang otomatis sampai berhasil atau timeout
Seluruh file test diulang tanpa batas sampai setiap test di dalamnya akhirnya berhasil lulus
Cypress otomatis mengirim ulang bug report ke tracker yang sebelumnya gagal terkirim
Aksi seperti click dijalankan berulang kali sampai halaman akhirnya berubah state-nya
en: Queries like cy.get and the assertions after them are retried automatically until they pass or time out
The whole test file is repeated without any limit until every single test inside it passes
Cypress automatically resends bug reports to the tracker that failed to be delivered earlier
Actions such as click are executed again and again until the page finally changes state

exp.id: Retry berlaku pada query dan assertion, sehingga menunggu elemen muncul tidak butuh sleep. Aksi seperti click tidak diulang begitu saja.
exp.en: Retrying applies to queries and assertions, so waiting for an element needs no sleep. Actions such as click are not simply repeated.

q.id: Test Anda harus berpindah dari app.example.com ke login.partner.com di tengah skenario. Apa yang dipakai?
q.en: Your test must go from app.example.com to login.partner.com mid-scenario. What do you use?

id: cy.origin() untuk menjalankan perintah di origin kedua
Tidak mungkin; Cypress selalu gagal pada domain berbeda
cy.wait() sampai domain pertama berubah menjadi domain kedua sendiri
Menjalankan dua test terpisah dan menggabungkan hasilnya manual
en: cy.origin() to run commands in the second origin
Impossible; Cypress always fails on a different domain
cy.wait() until the first domain turns into the second by itself
Running two separate tests and merging the results by hand

exp.id: cy.origin() memungkinkan alur lintas origin dalam satu test (dengan batasan coverage callback). Ini bagian dari batasan same-origin yang perlu diketahui.
exp.en: cy.origin() enables cross-origin flows in one test (with callback scope limits). It is part of the same-origin constraint you should know about.

q.id: Apa yang dilakukan Cypress terhadap cookie dan local storage di antara test (test isolation)?
q.en: What does Cypress do with cookies and local storage between tests (test isolation)?

id: Membersihkannya secara default agar tiap test mulai dari state bersih
Mengumpulkannya sepanjang seluruh run agar semua test saling berbagi sesi
Mengirimkannya ke server Cypress untuk dianalisis
Mengenkripsinya lalu menyimpannya selamanya
en: Clears them by default so each test starts from a clean state
Accumulates them across the whole run so all tests share a session
Sends them to a Cypress server for analysis
Encrypts them and stores them forever

exp.id: Test isolation membuat test independen. Untuk menghemat login yang berulang, pakai cy.session() yang menyimpan dan memulihkan sesi secara sengaja.
exp.en: Test isolation keeps tests independent. To avoid repeating logins, use cy.session(), which saves and restores a session deliberately.

q.id: Untuk apa Cypress.Commands.add()?
q.en: What is Cypress.Commands.add() for?

id: Membuat custom command yang dapat dipakai ulang di banyak test
Menambah anggota baru ke tim Cypress Cloud
Menginstal browser tambahan secara otomatis
Mengubah versi aplikasi yang sedang diuji
en: Creating a custom command reusable across many tests
Adding new members to a Cypress Cloud team
Installing extra browsers automatically
Changing the version of the application under test

exp.id: Custom command membungkus langkah berulang (misalnya login) menjadi satu perintah sehingga test lebih ringkas.
exp.en: A custom command wraps repeated steps (e.g. login) into one command so tests stay short.

q.id: Selector mana yang paling stabil untuk elemen yang akan sering berubah tampilannya?
q.en: Which selector is most stable for an element whose look will change often?

id: [data-cy=submit] (atribut khusus test)
.btn.btn-lg.btn-blue
div:nth-child(4) > span
Teks tombol "Kirim Sekarang!" yang sering diganti tim marketing
en: [data-cy=submit] (a test-dedicated attribute)
.btn.btn-lg.btn-blue
div:nth-child(4) > span
The button text "Send Now!" that marketing keeps changing

exp.id: Atribut data-cy hanya berubah bila tim test memang mengubahnya, sedangkan class, urutan, dan teks berubah mengikuti desain atau copywriting.
exp.en: A data-cy attribute only changes when the test owners change it, whereas classes, order and text change with design or copywriting.

q.id: Apa fungsi cy.session()?
q.en: What is cy.session() for?

id: Menyimpan dan memulihkan cookie, local storage sesi login antar test agar tidak login berulang
Menambah jumlah sesi user bersamaan yang dapat dilayani aplikasi di production environment
Mengatur batas waktu global yang berlaku untuk seluruh eksekusi Cypress di mesin tersebut
Merekam video seluruh layar komputer selama test sedang berjalan di mesin tersebut
en: Saving and restoring login cookies and local storage between tests to avoid repeated logins
Increasing the number of concurrent user sessions that the production application can serve
Setting the global timeout that applies to the whole Cypress run on the machine
Recording a video of the complete computer screen while the tests are running

exp.id: cy.session menjaga isolasi tetapi menghemat waktu: login dijalankan sekali per kunci sesi lalu dipulihkan.
exp.en: cy.session keeps isolation while saving time: login runs once per session key and is then restored.

q.id: Apa kegunaan component testing di Cypress?
q.en: What is component testing in Cypress for?

id: Memasang dan menguji satu komponen UI secara terpisah tanpa menjalankan seluruh aplikasi
Menguji koneksi antar server database secara langsung tanpa user interface
Menghitung jumlah baris kode dan melaporkan totalnya untuk setiap folder repositori
Menggantikan setiap test end-to-end di proyek tanpa terkecuali sama sekali
en: Mounting and testing a single UI component in isolation without running the whole app
Testing the connections between database servers directly without a user interface
Counting the lines of code and reporting the totals for each folder of the repository
Replacing every single end-to-end test in the project without any exception at all

exp.id: Component testing lebih cepat dan fokus; ia melengkapi, bukan menggantikan, test end-to-end.
exp.en: Component testing is faster and focused; it complements, not replaces, end-to-end tests.

q.id: Manajer meminta satu test Cypress yang membuka dua tab browser dan berpindah di antaranya. Respons terbaik?
q.en: A manager asks for one Cypress test that opens two browser tabs and switches between them. Best response?

id: Jelaskan batasan multi-tab Cypress; sarankan memisahkan skenario atau memakai tool lain (misalnya Playwright) untuk kasus itu
Setujui dan tulis test yang mungkin berhasil tanpa memverifikasi bahwa tab kedua benar-benar terkendali
Tolak seluruh otomasi UI di proyek karena satu skenario tidak didukung oleh tool tersebut
Ganti seluruh suite ke tool lain sekarang juga tanpa analisis biaya atau usaha migrasinya
en: Explain Cypress's multi-tab limitation; suggest splitting the scenario or using another tool (e.g. Playwright) for that case
Agree and write a test that might work without verifying that the second tab is really controlled
Reject all UI automation for the project because one single scenario is not supported by the tool
Switch the entire suite to another tool immediately without any analysis of cost or migration effort

exp.id: Jawaban yang matang menyebut batasan, menawarkan alternatif, dan mempertimbangkan biaya. Memilih tool adalah keputusan berdasarkan kebutuhan, bukan kesetiaan.
exp.en: A mature answer states the limitation, offers alternatives and weighs cost. Tool choice follows needs, not loyalty.

q.id: Apa manfaat utama Object Repository di Katalon Studio?
q.en: What is the main benefit of the Object Repository in Katalon Studio?

id: Menyimpan test object (locator) terpusat sehingga perubahan UI cukup diperbaiki di satu tempat
Menyimpan seluruh kode sumber aplikasi yang diuji untuk setiap release yang ada
Menyimpan password semua user aplikasi secara polos untuk keperluan test
Menjalankan test dengan sendirinya tanpa memerlukan test case sama sekali
en: Keeps test objects (locators) in one place so a UI change is fixed once
Stores the complete source code of the application under test for every release
Stores the passwords of all application users in plain text for the test runs
Runs tests automatically on its own without the need for any test case at all

exp.id: Konsepnya mirip Page Object Model: locator dikelola terpusat dan dipakai ulang oleh banyak test case.
exp.en: The idea is close to the Page Object Model: locators are managed centrally and reused by many test cases.

q.id: Apa beda Test Suite dan Test Suite Collection di Katalon?
q.en: What is the difference between a Test Suite and a Test Suite Collection in Katalon?

id: Test Suite mengelompokkan test case; Collection menjalankan beberapa test suite (misalnya di beberapa browser atau profil)
Keduanya fitur yang identik, dan satu-satunya perbedaan hanya nama folder tempatnya berada
Test Suite hanya untuk aplikasi mobile sedangkan Collection hanya untuk aplikasi web
Collection hanya boleh berisi satu test case dan tidak boleh berisi apa pun lainnya
en: A Test Suite groups test cases; a Collection runs several test suites (e.g. across browsers or profiles)
They are identical features, and the only difference is the name of the folder they live in
A Test Suite is meant for mobile apps only while a Collection is meant for web apps only
A Collection can contain exactly one test case and nothing else, unlike a normal suite

exp.id: Collection berguna untuk eksekusi lintas browser atau environment: tiap suite dijalankan dengan konfigurasinya sendiri.
exp.en: A Collection is useful for cross-browser or cross-environment runs: each suite runs with its own configuration.

q.id: Anda ingin test yang sama berjalan di environment staging dan production-like tanpa mengubah test case. Apa yang dipakai?
q.en: You want the same test to run on staging and a production-like environment without editing test cases. What do you use?

id: Execution Profile dengan variabel per environment (URL, akun uji)
Menyalin test case lalu mengubah URL secara manual di dalam setiap salinannya
Menulis URL langsung ke dalam setiap langkah pada test case tersebut
Menonaktifkan environment yang sedang tidak dipakai oleh seluruh tim
en: An Execution Profile with per-environment variables (URL, test accounts)
Copying the test case and editing the URL by hand inside each of the copies
Hard-coding the URL directly into every single step of the test case
Disabling the environment that is not currently being used by the whole team

exp.id: Profil memisahkan konfigurasi dari test sehingga satu test case dipakai untuk banyak environment.
exp.en: Profiles separate configuration from the test so one test case serves many environments.

q.id: Bagaimana data-driven testing dilakukan di Katalon?
q.en: How is data-driven testing done in Katalon?

id: Menghubungkan Test Data (Excel, CSV, database) ke variabel test case sehingga test berjalan per baris data
Menulis ulang test case yang sama sekali lagi untuk setiap baris data yang ada
Memasukkan semua baris data langsung ke Object Repository sebagai test object
Menunggu user sungguhan mengetik data ke formulir satu per satu selama run
en: Binding Test Data (Excel, CSV, database) to test case variables so the test runs once per data row
Rewriting the same test case again once for every single row of data that exists
Putting all the data rows directly into the Object Repository as test objects
Waiting for real users to type the data into the form one by one during the run

exp.id: Binding Test Data pada test suite membuat satu test case dieksekusi berulang dengan data berbeda.
exp.en: Binding Test Data in a test suite makes one test case execute repeatedly with different data.

q.id: Apa itu self-healing di Katalon Studio?
q.en: What is self-healing in Katalon Studio?

id: Mencoba locator alternatif secara otomatis saat locator utama gagal menemukan elemen
Memperbaiki bug aplikasi secara otomatis sehingga developer tidak perlu lagi
Menghapus test yang gagal dari proyek sehingga laporan hanya menampilkan yang lulus
Mengganti sistem operasi mesin supaya test dapat lulus dengan sendirinya
en: Automatically trying alternative locators when the primary locator fails to find the element
Fixing the bugs in the application automatically so developers no longer have to
Deleting failed tests from the project so that the report shows only passes
Replacing the operating system of the machine so that the tests can pass

exp.id: Self-healing mengurangi failure karena perubahan locator, tetapi hasilnya tetap perlu ditinjau agar locator yang "disembuhkan" tidak menunjuk elemen yang salah.
exp.en: Self-healing reduces failures from locator changes, but the result should still be reviewed so a healed locator does not point to the wrong element.

q.id: Bahasa apa yang dipakai untuk custom keyword dan script di Katalon Studio?
q.en: Which language is used for custom keywords and scripts in Katalon Studio?

id: Groovy
COBOL
Assembly
Fortran
en: Groovy
COBOL
Assembly
Fortran

exp.id: Katalon Studio berbasis Groovy/Java sehingga library Java dapat dipakai di script.
exp.en: Katalon Studio is Groovy/Java based, so Java libraries can be used in scripts.

q.id: Pada keyword WebUI.verifyElementPresent, apa fungsi FailureHandling.CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE?
q.en: On a WebUI.verifyElementPresent keyword, what does FailureHandling.CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE do?

id: Mencatat failure tetapi melanjutkan langkah berikutnya, dan test case akhirnya ditandai gagal
Mengabaikan failure sepenuhnya, seolah verifikasi itu tidak pernah dijalankan
Menghentikan seluruh eksekusi seketika dan menghapus semua hasil sejauh ini
Mengulang keyword tanpa batas sampai akhirnya berhasil dengan sendirinya
en: Logs the failure but continues with the next steps, and the test case is finally marked failed
Ignores the failure completely, as if the verification had never been executed
Stops the whole execution immediately and deletes all of the results so far
Repeats the keyword without any limit until it finally succeeds on its own

exp.id: STOP_ON_FAILURE menghentikan test, CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE melanjutkan tetapi status akhir gagal, OPTIONAL hanya memberi peringatan. Pilih sesuai pentingnya langkah.
exp.en: STOP_ON_FAILURE halts the test, CONTINUE_ON_FAILURE continues but the final status is failed, OPTIONAL only warns. Choose by how critical the step is.

q.id: Bagaimana test Katalon dijalankan di pipeline CI tanpa membuka interface Studio?
q.en: How do you run Katalon tests in a CI pipeline without opening the Studio UI?

id: Lewat Katalon Runtime Engine / command line dengan parameter proyek dan test suite
Mengirim email berisi seluruh proyek ke tim QA tiap malam agar ada yang menjalankannya
Meminta setiap developer menjalankan test manual di laptop masing-masing per commit
Tidak mungkin, karena test Katalon hanya berjalan di dalam jendela Studio yang terbuka
en: Through Katalon Runtime Engine / the command line with project and test suite parameters
Emailing the whole project to the QA team every night so that someone runs it
Asking each developer to run the tests manually on their own laptop per commit
It is not possible, because Katalon tests run only inside an opened Studio window

exp.id: Mode command line (Runtime Engine) memungkinkan eksekusi headless di CI, lalu hasilnya dikirim ke laporan atau platform seperti TestOps.
exp.en: Command-line mode (Runtime Engine) allows headless execution in CI, with results sent to reports or a platform such as TestOps.

q.id: Tim Anda terdiri dari tester non-programmer yang butuh otomasi web, API, dan mobile dalam satu tool. Pertimbangan paling seimbang?
q.en: Your team is non-programmer testers who need web, API and mobile automation in one tool. What is the most balanced consideration?

id: Katalon cocok untuk kebutuhan itu, dengan catatan soal lisensi, keterikatan tool, dan keterbatasan integrasi dibanding framework kode
Katalon selalu pilihan terbaik, dan framework kode tidak pernah dibutuhkan tim mana pun
Framework kode selalu pilihan terbaik, dan tool low-code tidak pernah layak dipakai
Pilih tool apa pun yang paling populer di media sosial bulan ini, apa pun kondisi tim
en: Katalon fits that need, noting licensing, tool lock-in and integration limits compared with code frameworks
Katalon is always the best choice, and code frameworks are never needed by any team
Code frameworks are always the best choice, and low-code tools are never a viable option
Choose whichever tool is the most popular on social media this month, whatever the team is

exp.id: Jawaban interview yang baik menimbang kecocokan tim, biaya, dan batasan, bukan fanatisme pada satu pendekatan.
exp.en: A good interview answer weighs team fit, cost and limits, not zeal for a single approach.

q.id: Apa kegunaan Web Recorder / Spy Web di Katalon Studio?
q.en: What are Web Recorder / Spy Web used for in Katalon Studio?

id: Menangkap elemen halaman sebagai test object dan merekam interaksi sebagai langkah awal test
Mengunci halaman web supaya developer tidak lagi dapat mengubah elemen-elemennya
Menghitung jumlah pengunjung yang membuka situs produksi sepanjang minggu ini
Menerjemahkan aplikasi yang diuji ke bahasa lain untuk pemeriksaan lokalisasi
en: Capturing page elements as test objects and recording interactions as starting test steps
Locking the web page so that developers are no longer able to change its elements
Counting the number of visitors who have opened the production website this week
Translating the application under test into other languages for localisation checks

exp.id: Hasil rekaman cepat untuk memulai tetapi perlu dirapikan: locator stabil, wait, dan assertion yang bermakna.
exp.en: Recordings are a quick start but need tidying: stable locators, waits and meaningful assertions.

id: sql-007

q.id: Cara mengambil pesanan terbaru milik tiap customer (satu baris per customer)?
q.en: How do you get each customer's latest order (one row per customer)?

id: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) rn FROM orders o) x WHERE rn = 1;
SELECT customer_id, MAX(id) FROM orders GROUP BY created_at;
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM orders WHERE created_at = NOW();
en: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) rn FROM orders o) x WHERE rn = 1;
SELECT customer_id, MAX(id) FROM orders GROUP BY created_at;
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM orders WHERE created_at = NOW();

exp.id: ROW_NUMBER() dengan PARTITION BY menomori pesanan per customer; rn = 1 adalah yang terbaru. Opsi pertama hanya mengembalikan satu baris total, bukan per customer.
exp.en: ROW_NUMBER() with PARTITION BY numbers orders per customer; rn = 1 is the latest. The first option returns a single row overall, not one per customer.

id: sql-008

q.id: Query mana yang menemukan email yang terdaftar lebih dari sekali?
q.en: Which query finds emails registered more than once?

id: SELECT email FROM users GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT email FROM users WHERE COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT DISTINCT email FROM users HAVING email > 1;
SELECT email FROM users ORDER BY COUNT(email);
en: SELECT email FROM users GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT email FROM users WHERE COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT DISTINCT email FROM users HAVING email > 1;
SELECT email FROM users ORDER BY COUNT(email);

exp.id: HAVING memfilter hasil kelompok setelah GROUP BY. COUNT(*) tidak boleh berada di WHERE karena WHERE bekerja sebelum pengelompokan.
exp.en: HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY. COUNT(*) cannot go in WHERE because WHERE runs before grouping.

id: sql-009

q.id: Kolom phone berisi 100 baris, 40 di antaranya NULL. Apa hasil COUNT(phone) dan COUNT(*)?
q.en: The phone column has 100 rows, 40 of them NULL. What do COUNT(phone) and COUNT(*) return?

id: COUNT(phone)=100 dan COUNT(*)=60
COUNT(phone)=60 dan COUNT(*)=100
Keduanya 100
Keduanya 60
en: COUNT(phone)=100 and COUNT(*)=60
COUNT(phone)=60 and COUNT(*)=100
Both are 100
Both are 60

exp.id: COUNT(kolom) mengabaikan NULL sehingga 60; COUNT(*) menghitung semua baris sehingga 100.
exp.en: COUNT(column) ignores NULLs so it is 60; COUNT(*) counts all rows so it is 100.

id: sql-010

q.id: Mengapa SELECT * FROM a WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT a_id FROM b) bisa mengembalikan nol baris padahal ada data yatim?
q.en: Why can SELECT * FROM a WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT a_id FROM b) return zero rows even though orphans exist?

id: Bila subquery berisi NULL, perbandingan NOT IN menjadi tidak diketahui sehingga tidak ada baris lolos
NOT IN hanya bekerja pada tabel dengan satu baris, sehingga tabel besar tak mengembalikan apa pun
Subquery selalu dijalankan sebelum tabel luar sempat dibuat di dalam memori
Database diam-diam membuang setiap baris yang id-nya kebetulan berupa angka genap
en: If the subquery contains NULL, NOT IN becomes unknown so no row passes
NOT IN only works on tables that contain a single row, so larger tables return nothing
The subquery is always executed before the outer table has been created in memory
The database silently drops every row whose id happens to be an even number

exp.id: Logika tiga nilai SQL: x NOT IN (..., NULL) tidak pernah benar. Gunakan NOT EXISTS atau LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL untuk mencari data yatim.
exp.en: SQL's three-valued logic: x NOT IN (..., NULL) is never true. Use NOT EXISTS or LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL to find orphans.

id: sql-011

q.id: LEFT JOIN orders o ON ... WHERE o.status = 'PAID' ternyata menghilangkan customer tanpa pesanan. Mengapa?
q.en: LEFT JOIN orders o ON ... WHERE o.status = 'PAID' drops customers with no orders. Why?

id: Kondisi di WHERE pada tabel kanan menyaring baris NULL sehingga efeknya seperti INNER JOIN; pindahkan ke ON
LEFT JOIN tidak boleh digabung dengan kolom status, sehingga query diam-diam berubah menjadi scan biasa
PAID adalah kata terlarang di SQL, sehingga database membuang customer yang tidak punya pesanan
Database menghapus customer tanpa pesanan dari tabel aslinya secara fisik setelah query dijalankan
en: A WHERE condition on the right table filters out the NULL rows so it behaves like an INNER JOIN; move it to ON
LEFT JOIN cannot be combined with a status column, so the query silently falls back to a plain scan
PAID is a reserved word in SQL, which makes the database discard the customers that have no orders
The database physically deletes customers without orders from the underlying table after the query

exp.id: Baris tanpa pesanan memiliki o.status NULL, yang tidak memenuhi o.status = 'PAID'. Menaruh kondisi di ON mempertahankan customer tanpa pesanan.
exp.en: Rows without orders have o.status NULL, which fails o.status = 'PAID'. Putting the condition in ON keeps customers without orders.

id: sql-012

q.id: Anda perlu membersihkan test data milik satu user saja. Pernyataan mana yang tepat?
q.en: You need to clean up test data for one user only. Which statement is right?

id: DELETE FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42;
TRUNCATE TABLE orders RESTART IDENTITY;
DROP TABLE orders CASCADE;
UPDATE orders SET status = 'x';
en: DELETE FROM orders WHERE user_id = 42;
TRUNCATE TABLE orders RESTART IDENTITY;
DROP TABLE orders CASCADE;
UPDATE orders SET status = 'x';

exp.id: DELETE dengan WHERE menghapus baris tertentu saja dan bisa dibatalkan dalam transaksi. TRUNCATE mengosongkan seluruh tabel dan DROP menghapus tabelnya.
exp.en: DELETE with WHERE removes only the chosen rows and can be rolled back in a transaction. TRUNCATE empties the whole table and DROP removes the table itself.

id: sql-013

q.id: Query mana yang paling mungkin tidak bisa memakai indeks pada kolom name?
q.en: Which query is least likely to use an index on the name column?

id: WHERE name LIKE '%budi'
WHERE name = 'budi'
WHERE name LIKE 'budi%'
WHERE name IN ('budi','sari')
en: WHERE name LIKE '%budi'
WHERE name = 'budi'
WHERE name LIKE 'budi%'
WHERE name IN ('budi','sari')

exp.id: Wildcard di awal membuat pencarian tidak bisa memanfaatkan urutan indeks sehingga cenderung table scan. Pola awalan 'budi%' masih bisa memakai indeks.
exp.en: A leading wildcard cannot use the index ordering, so it tends to scan the table. A prefix pattern like 'budi%' can still use the index.

id: sql-014

q.id: Apa beda UNION dan UNION ALL?
q.en: What is the difference between UNION and UNION ALL?

id: UNION menghapus baris duplikat; UNION ALL mempertahankan semuanya dan umumnya lebih cepat
UNION ALL menghapus baris duplikat, sedangkan UNION mempertahankan semua baris yang ditemukan
Keduanya berperilaku persis sama, dan hanya kata kunci yang ditulis yang berbeda
UNION bekerja untuk paling banyak dua tabel, UNION ALL dipakai untuk tiga tabel atau lebih
en: UNION removes duplicate rows; UNION ALL keeps all of them and is usually faster
UNION ALL removes duplicate rows, while UNION keeps all of the rows that it finds
They behave exactly the same, and only the keyword that is written differs between them
UNION works for two tables at most, and UNION ALL is used for three tables or more

exp.id: Penghapusan duplikat butuh pengurutan atau hashing tambahan, jadi UNION ALL lebih murah bila duplikat tidak masalah atau mustahil.
exp.en: Removing duplicates needs extra sorting or hashing, so UNION ALL is cheaper when duplicates do not matter or cannot occur.

id: sql-015

q.id: Transfer saldo gagal di tengah jalan: saldo pengirim sudah berkurang tetapi penerima belum bertambah. Properti ACID mana yang dilanggar?
q.en: A balance transfer fails midway: the sender was debited but the receiver not credited. Which ACID property is violated?

id: Atomicity (transaksi harus tuntas seluruhnya atau tidak sama sekali)
Durability (data hilang begitu aliran listrik server dimatikan)
Isolation (dua user yang bekerja bersamaan melihat kumpulan data yang berbeda)
Consistency saja, yang sama sekali tidak berhubungan dengan penanganan transaksi
en: Atomicity (a transaction must complete entirely or not at all)
Durability (data is lost once the power supply of the server is switched off)
Isolation (two users working at the same moment see a different set of data)
Consistency only, which has no relation at all with how transactions are handled

exp.id: Atomicity menjamin dua langkah transfer diperlakukan sebagai satu kesatuan; bila salah satu gagal, seluruhnya dibatalkan (rollback).
exp.en: Atomicity guarantees the two transfer steps are treated as one unit; if one fails everything is rolled back.

id: sql-016

q.id: Query mana yang menemukan pesanan yang customer_id-nya tidak ada di tabel customers?
q.en: Which query finds orders whose customer_id does not exist in customers?

id: SELECT o.* FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IS NULL;
SELECT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id > 0;
SELECT o.* FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.customer_id > 0;
SELECT c.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL;
en: SELECT o.* FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IS NULL;
SELECT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id > 0;
SELECT o.* FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.customer_id > 0;
SELECT c.* FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL;

exp.id: LEFT JOIN lalu c.id IS NULL menampilkan baris yang tidak punya pasangan: cara standar memeriksa integritas referensial. INNER JOIN justru hanya menampilkan yang cocok.
exp.en: LEFT JOIN then c.id IS NULL shows rows with no match: the standard referential-integrity check. INNER JOIN shows only matching rows.

id: int-007

q.id: Ceritakan bug tersulit yang pernah Anda temukan dan bagaimana Anda menanganinya.
q.en: Tell me about the hardest bug you found and how you handled it.

model.id: Gunakan STAR: konteks singkat, langkah reproduksi dan penyempitan penyebab (log, data, environment), kerja sama dengan developer sampai root cause, dampak bisnis, lalu pelajaran atau pencegahan (regression test baru, perbaikan proses). Hindari menyebut data internal perusahaan.
model.en: Use STAR: brief context, reproduction and narrowing down the cause (logs, data, environment), working with developers to the root cause, business impact, then the lesson or prevention (new regression test, process fix). Avoid naming internal company data.

id: int-008

q.id: Developer menolak bug yang Anda laporkan dengan alasan "itu bukan bug". Apa yang Anda lakukan?
q.en: A developer rejects a bug you reported saying "that's not a bug". What do you do?

model.id: Cek ulang bukti dan reproduksi, rujuk requirement atau acceptance criteria, diskusikan langsung (bukan hanya lewat komentar), jelaskan dampak ke user, dan bila tetap berbeda libatkan product owner untuk memutuskan. Pertahankan sikap konstruktif, bukan menyalahkan.
model.en: Re-check evidence and reproduction, refer to the requirement or acceptance criteria, discuss directly (not only via comments), explain the user impact, and if opinions still differ involve the product owner to decide. Stay constructive, not blaming.

id: int-009

q.id: Bagaimana Anda menguji fitur login?
q.en: How would you test a login feature?

model.id: Klarifikasi requirement lalu rancang test: kredensial valid dan tidak valid, nilai batas panjang input, karakter khusus, akun terkunci setelah percobaan gagal, sesi dan logout, "ingat saya", security (brute force, SQL injection, pesan error yang tidak membocorkan keberadaan akun), accessibility, dan performance. Putuskan mana yang diotomasi.
model.en: Clarify requirements, then design tests: valid and invalid credentials, input length boundaries, special characters, lockout after failed attempts, session and logout, "remember me", security (brute force, SQL injection, error messages that do not reveal account existence), accessibility and performance. Decide what to automate.

id: int-010

q.id: Bagaimana Anda memutuskan bahwa sebuah release aman untuk dirilis (go/no-go)?
q.en: How do you decide that a release is safe to ship (go/no-go)?

model.id: Berdasarkan bukti, bukan perasaan: exit criteria terpenuhi (coverage, test kritis lulus), defect terbuka beserta severity dan workaround, risiko residual, hasil regression dan smoke di environment mirip produksi, rencana rollback, lalu keputusan bersama stakeholder yang menerima risikonya.
model.en: Based on evidence, not feeling: exit criteria met (coverage, critical tests pass), open defects with severity and workarounds, residual risk, regression and smoke results on a production-like environment, a rollback plan, then a joint decision with stakeholders who accept the risk.

id: int-011

q.id: Test otomatis Anda kadang lulus kadang gagal (flaky). Bagaimana Anda menanganinya?
q.en: Your automated test sometimes passes and sometimes fails (flaky). How do you handle it?

model.id: Cari root cause dulu: wait yang salah, data bersama antar test, ketergantungan urutan, environment tidak stabil, atau race condition di aplikasi. Kumpulkan bukti (log, trace, video), perbaiki penyebabnya, karantina sementara test yang mengganggu pipeline, dan pakai retry hanya sebagai jaring pengaman, bukan solusi.
model.en: Find the root cause first: wrong waits, data shared between tests, order dependence, an unstable environment or a race condition in the app. Gather evidence (logs, traces, video), fix the cause, quarantine the test temporarily if it blocks the pipeline, and use retries only as a safety net, not a solution.

id: int-012

q.id: Anda diminta menguji sebuah API tanpa dokumentasi. Bagaimana langkah Anda?
q.en: You are asked to test an API with no documentation. What are your steps?

model.id: Cari sumber informasi: tanya developer, baca kode atau OpenAPI/Swagger bila ada, amati lalu lintas dari aplikasi client. Jelajahi endpoint secara eksploratori (method, status, header, error), catat temuan sebagai kontrak sementara, konfirmasi ke developer, lalu ubah menjadi test otomatis yang mencakup positif, negatif, autentikasi, dan batas.
model.en: Find information sources: ask developers, read the code or OpenAPI/Swagger if available, observe traffic from the client app. Explore endpoints exploratively (methods, status, headers, errors), record findings as a provisional contract, confirm with developers, then turn it into automated tests covering positive, negative, authentication and boundaries.
